stages.title: Selected versioned assemblies
stages.description: Use a prior selected input panel only after hash verification. No fabricated assemblies, species panels, or added Enterococcus records.

stages.title: Annotated proteomes
stages.description: Carry forward only annotated proteomes derived from the selected assemblies.

stages.title: Conserved marker families
stages.description: Identify conserved marker families before downstream tree building.

stages.title: Separate alignments
stages.description: Maintain separate alignments per marker family; do not collapse them into a fabricated single result.

stages.title: IQ-TREE host tree
stages.description: Infer the host tree from alignment outputs only after upstream evidence is verified.

stages.title: Independent R-M detection
stages.description: Run independent restriction-modification detection separate from host tree inference.

stages.title: Locus review
stages.description: Review loci manually with explicit evidence links and human approval gates.

stages.title: Four rings
stages.description: Publish four evidence-bound visualization rings only from verified upstream artifacts.
